premise: At the lagoon Plesiosaur and Ammonite play copy-me, and Dragonfly copies every move from the air — the dive, the twirl — until Ammonite shoots backwards, and Dragonfly zips backwards too.
inspiration: The copy-cat game of folk rhymes ('Simon says'), turned: the one nobody thought could copy has the best trick of all.
lesson: Everyone can join the game in their own way.
learning: Dragonflies can hover in one spot and even fly backwards.

en-US.title: Dragonfly Goes Backwards
en-US.text: {dragonfly:float loop 0.3} [playfully] Splish, splash! {plesiosaur:enter} Plesiosaur and {ammonite:enter} Ammonite were playing copy-me in the water. {plesiosaur:face happy} Whatever one did, the other did too. {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go to plesiosaur} {sfx:buzz} Dragonfly came zipping over. [curious] "Can I play?" "But you can't swim!" said Plesiosaur, smiling. "I'll copy from up here," said Dragonfly. So Plesiosaur {plesiosaur:live dive} {sfx:splash} dived, splash, and popped up again. {dragonfly:live dip} Dragonfly dipped down to the water and up. {ammonite:spin} Ammonite twirled round. {dragonfly:spin} Dragonfly twirled too. [giggles] {ammonite:face happy} "Copy THIS," said Ammonite. And {ammonite:live jet} whoosh! She shot backwards, shell first. {plesiosaur:face surprised} [excited] "Nobody can go backwards!" But Dragonfly {dragonfly:live dart} darted forwards, stopped short in the air… and zipped BACKWARDS. {ammonite:face surprised} "How did you do that?" [proudly] "Dragonflies can," said Dragonfly. And {dragonfly:live hover} she hung there in the air, perfectly still. {plesiosaur:face happy} Plesiosaur tried to swim backwards… {plesiosaur:spin} and only went round in a circle. [laughs] {all:face happy} So the game went on all afternoon: forwards, backwards, and round and round.

es-ES.title: Libélula marcha atrás
es-ES.text: {dragonfly:float loop 0.3} [playfully] ¡Chof, chof! {plesiosaur:enter} Plesiosaurio y {ammonite:enter} Amonites jugaban a copiarse en el agua. {plesiosaur:face happy} Lo que hacía uno, lo hacía la otra. {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go to plesiosaur} {sfx:buzz} Libélula llegó zumbando. [curious] —¿Puedo jugar? —Pero si tú no sabes nadar —dijo Plesiosaurio, sonriendo. —Os copio desde aquí arriba —dijo Libélula. Así que Plesiosaurio {plesiosaur:live dive} {sfx:splash} se zambulló, ¡chof!, y volvió a asomar. {dragonfly:live dip} Libélula bajó hasta rozar el agua y volvió a subir. {ammonite:spin} Amonites dio una vuelta. {dragonfly:spin} Libélula, también. [giggles] {ammonite:face happy} —¡A ver si copiáis esto! —dijo Amonites. Y {ammonite:live jet} ¡fiuuu!, salió disparada hacia atrás, con la concha por delante. {plesiosaur:face surprised} [excited] —¡Eso no lo copia nadie! Pero Libélula {dragonfly:live dart} salió hacia delante, frenó en seco en el aire… y ¡zas!, volvió MARCHA ATRÁS. {ammonite:face surprised} —¿Cómo lo has hecho? [proudly] —Las libélulas sabemos —dijo Libélula. Y {dragonfly:live hover} se quedó quietecita en el aire, sin moverse nada. {plesiosaur:face happy} Plesiosaurio intentó nadar hacia atrás… {plesiosaur:spin} y solo dio vueltas en redondo. [laughs] {all:face happy} Y el juego siguió toda la tarde: hacia delante, hacia atrás, y en redondo.

buzz.prompt: a dragonfly's wings buzzing past close by, a quick papery whirr, realistic

splash.prompt: a big gentle animal diving head first into a calm lake, one soft splash and a few drips, realistic
